fields.description: Issue includes extensive investigative coverage alleging misconduct by Dr. T. Earl Moore (the "Torture Doctor"), including claims of influence over the Koenig family and Paul’s Boat Supply Co. and discussion of a death by burning connected to the case. Editorial content argues for municipal ownership of Florida Power & Light and discusses utility nationalization. Local court and public-safety reporting covers juvenile-caused train wrecks in the Hialeah area, a municipal-court discussion of sex-offense cases involving children, and a legal notice in Dade County. A multi-page health feature reprints and summarizes a Consumer Reports article on polio organizations and the Sister Kenny controversy, alongside letters to the editor and community notices; the issue also contains entertainment and nightlife advertising.
